{{Quote|Goril Sevintran. I arrived with the first wave. Now I serve among the last.|Goril Sevintran|<ref name="Jedi Commander" />}}
'''Goril Sevintran''' was an [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When the Empire [[Battle of Corellia|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], Sevintran was among the first [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] sent to aid the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] people and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] on the embattled [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I have been here since the fighting began. I have seen much.|Goril Sevintran|<ref name="Jedi Commander" />}}
An [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="Jedipedia" /> Goril Sevintran was inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and had begun serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] was invaded by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in that year as part of the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and Sevintran was part of the first group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who were sent to aid the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] in the [[Battle of Corellia]]. During the lengthy fighting against the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], many Jedi were [[Death/Legends|killed]], and Sevintran was among the few Jedi still on Corellia's surface when [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] dispatched Jedi reinforcements from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I do not wish to kill, but I cannot feel bad about taking our enemies' lives.|Goril Sevintran|<ref name="Jedi Commander" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Advozse male with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], orange-brown skin, and a dark brown horn<ref name="Jedipedia" /> common to his [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Galaxy">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> Sevintran was proud to be a member of the Jedi Order and believed that unity would allow the Republic and the Jedi to win the fight for Corellia. He also believed that the Empire would never surrender and had to be destroyed, though Sevintran forced himself to ignore his aversion to killing when it came to defeating the enemy and saving lives.<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a member of the Jedi Order, Sevintran was proficient with both [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], and he was experienced enough to be granted the title of Jedi Knight.<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

==Equipment==
In battle, he wore bronze-colored [[Armor/Legends|armor]] over his [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]].<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Listen to my advice. Don't underestimate our adversary. The Empire has killed many Jedi. Victory may come at great cost.|Goril Sevintran, to players who chose not to redeem Praven|<ref name="Jedi Commander" />}}
[[File:The_Old_Republic_cover.png|thumb|right|200px|Sevintran appeared in the video game ''Star Wars: The Old Republic''.]]
Goril Sevintran first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] produced by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]]. Sevintran will only appear in the Jedi Knight mission "Jedi Commander" on Corellia if the player fails to redeem the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Praven]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during Act I, and Sevintran will then appear in Praven's place in the tunnel system in the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] district. He will continue to appear in Praven's place in all subsequent cutscenes, though neither Sevintran nor Praven speak to the player after their initial meeting.<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

As a Republic character, the Jedi Knight is assumed to only choose the moral [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] options,<ref name="Light Side">This article assumes that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] classes in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' choose the options that provide the most [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] alignment points.</ref> so this article assumes that the player successfully convinced Praven to become a Jedi and therefore never encountered Sevintran.<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> While his ultimate fate is left unknown in the light-side scenario, Sevintran's comments about his [[Time/Legends|time]] on Corellia before the [[Hero of Tython|Hero's]] arrival are still taken to be correct.<ref name="Light Side" />
